# discord_emojis (Data Source)

Lists the custom emojis of a server.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_emojis" "all" {
  server_id = var.server_id
}

output "emoji_ids" {
  value = { for e in data.discord_emojis.all.emojis : e.name => e.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild).

### Read-Only

- `emojis` (Attributes List) The emojis. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--emojis))

<a id="nestedatt--emojis"></a>
### Nested Schema for `emojis`

Read-Only:

- `animated` (Boolean) Whether the emoji is animated.
- `id` (String) Emoji ID.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the emoji is managed by an integration.
- `name` (String) Emoji name.
- `roles` (Set of String) IDs of the roles allowed to use the emoji; empty when everyone can.
